sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You may feel that you woke up on the wrong side of the bed today, says Ganesha. The day is filled with a fair share of jittery moments and lingering worry. Stand firm and remember that every night has a dawn. The law of averages will make your evening more enjoyable.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: It's likely that your personal and creative horizons are expanding, Taurus. Your or another's artistic enterprises might pay off big today. You could be introduced to people who prove to be valuable contacts as well as new friends. Your new feeling of enthusiasm and self-confidence certainly doesn't hurt!

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: If you're uncertain about where you stand with someone special, consider asking them point blank. Listen carefully to what others say, and it will be easy to fill in any gaps they leave.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Throw away the gloom- which is enveloping you and disrupting your progress. Dig deep beneath the surface to find out more about the investment scheme that seems to be attracting you- Consult your experts before making any commitment. It is high time to change your dominating attitude in family. Work in close cooperation with them to share the ups and downs of life. Your changed attitude will give them unlimited joy. You will feel that your creativity has been lost and you find it extremely difficult to make decisions. Today, you can go to a park or shopping mall with young members of the family.

readings.text: Technical problems may force you to rework on some programming codes. You may feel as if you are in a bind with your computer. You should not worry, it’s just for a day. As soon as you are done with work, you may want to rush home.

The endless chatter continues, but you will find that there is a new twist to the conversation. Someone is fighting back. Opposing opinions are struggling to be heard. Everyone may not be as agreeable as they have been during the past couple days.

readings.text: Ganesha feels that today you will be more logical and so you will be doing away with things that need not be part of your routine life. You will avoid doing things that call for heavy expenses.

You may need to reconsider recent financial plans. Your head is full of all kinds of amazingly creative ideas. If you're a writer, journalist, or publisher, this is a great time to be you. But you need to use these gifts in a responsible way. Make sure you're saving your money with a reliable company.

readings.text: Today, from health point of view, it is your weak day so you should not give strain to your brain or body much. You should take a break in between or else you may feel very tired.

It's a good day to heal old wounds. Maybe someone said something that hurt your feelings; maybe you know there is something out there between you and a friend that still needs clearing up. You will enjoy this transit even more if you take the time to exercise your body. The increase of oxygen to the blood makes communication even purer.

lucky.remedy: Offer help and services in any auspicious event such as marriages with full devotion and dedication. This will enable your business and work life to flourish.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: If you need inspiration to get in shape, grab a friend and try the buddy system.

You may discuss certain intimate issues with your sweetheart for the betterment of your relationship.

ac.text: Discussions around matters of the heart can take a serious turn, dearest Gemini, thanks to a sweet union between the Scorpio Moon and Mercury. Don't be afraid to put your feelings on the line, especially if you sense your companion feels the same. If you're uncertain about where you stand with someone special, consider asking them point blank. If you're not feeling so bold, a bit of flirting can help you determine if they're truly interested in getting to know you better. Listen carefully to what others say, and it will be easy to fill in any gaps they leave.
